projects.title: Checkpoint
projects.headline: Bus arrivals, built around confirmed checkpoints
projects.summary: A checkpoint-based bus arrival tracker for Philippine provincial routes.
projects.description: Checkpoint estimates provincial bus arrivals from conductor-confirmed checkpoints and baseline travel times, rather than continuous bus GPS tracking. Guests can find stops and inbound buses without an account, while conductors and operations staff use role-based tools.
bullets: Public station search and arrivals board with map-based stop discovery
Conductor checkpoint updates with offline queuing and synchronization
Role-based staff access and administration for routes, fleet, schedules and trips

gallery.label: Checkpoint public arrivals and stop search

caseStudy.problem: Help passengers discover inbound buses on provincial routes without relying on continuous GPS hardware.
caseStudy.approach: Conductor-confirmed checkpoints feed arrival estimates; separate guest, conductor and administrator experiences support the operational workflow.
caseStudy.contribution: Helped build the website and contributed as a QA tester in 2026.
